//: EXAMPLE config.json for a new Grupo US project. Comments use // keys (strip before saving as config.json). Substitute every <PLACEHOLDER>.

project.//: Identity. name = repo / slug id (kebab-case). displayName = human-readable.
project.name: <new-project-id>
project.stackSummary: <human-readable stack list — feeds CLAUDE.md project identity>

skills.//: Names of the skills used for brand canon, theme tokens, and tech-stack patterns. Must match folder names under .claude/skills/.

cardinals.//: Cardinal-rule values. Cardinals in CLAUDE.md gate on these. If your project differs (e.g., SSR not static), adjust here — never duplicate the cardinal text.

whatsapp.//: When enabled=false, cardinal #6 + whatsapp-ssot.md are dormant. When enabled=true, fill all fields and the helper file must exist.

commit.//: Conventional Commits scopes allowed for this project. Tailor to the project's surfaces.

paths.//: Empty path = layer not present. Plans must not invent layers.

tooling.//: Empty = layer absent. packageManager + buildTool + linter + typeChecker are most-referenced.

gates.//: Lighthouse + CWV thresholds. Adjust per project quality bar.

protectedFiles.//: Files that require explicit confirmation before editing. Add/remove per project surfaces.
